title: settings for vehicle mode
body:
Hi there, 
I tried vehicle mode and it works fine. I wonder, if there is a possibility to make a setting to enable "read values out loud" automatically in vehicle mode without enabeling it manually?! It would be a helpful feature don´t you think..?

comments.body: It would be nice to broadcast an alert value on the bluetooth audio. I've been thinking of getting a bluetooth headset for flying. It would satisfy my needs to check my blood sugars if the phone would announce my levels every 30 minutes or if they were low.
you have this feature ... enable "read values loud" an you get them also on the headset.

@CaroGo If I understand you correctly, you like a new setting to be added to xDrip.  
When set, enabling vehicle mode would automatically enable "speak readings".
When not set, enabling vehicle mode would not automatically enable speak readings.
Is that right?

I am closing this due to inactivity.
It does not seem like a feature that has no work-around.
We can always reopen if determined that this is needed by a large portion of the community and there is no work-around.
